overview_description.description:
AccelByte is a massively scalable and extensible backend platform for live game services that helps creators focus on what matters most: making awesome games. 

The AccelByte Cloud platform powers lobby, friends, cross-platform matchmaking, cloud progression, and season pass, among other services. Founded in 2016, AccelByte was created by game industry veterans who have engineered online systems behind some of the largest platforms in the world, including Epic Online Store, Xbox Live, and EA Origin and is backed by SoftBank Vision Fund 2, Galaxy Interactive, NetEase, KRAFTON, Dreamhaven, and key angel investors.

about_short_description.short_description: Massively scalable and extensible backend platform for live game services helping creators focus on what matters most: making awesome games.

product.name: AccelByte Gaming Services (AGS)
product.description: A scalable backend platform providing microservices for cross-platform accounts, matchmaking, in-game store, analytics, and player engagement.

product.name: AccelByte Development Toolkit (ADT)
product.description: A unified platform for game build distribution, crash reporting, playtesting, and performance profiling across multiple platforms.

product.name: AccelByte Intelligence Service (AIS)
product.description: A game analytics platform that captures, processes, and visualizes player and game data to support data-driven decision making.

product.name: AccelByte Multiplayer Servers (AMS)
product.description: A cloud-agnostic dedicated server solution offering low latency, elastic scaling, and regional server management for multiplayer games.

product.name: AccelByte Extend
product.description: A customization framework that allows developers to add or override backend logic in AccelByte Gaming Services without modifying the core platform.

product.name: Game Monetization Platform
product.description: A platform to manage in-game stores, virtual currencies, transactions, and promotional events across multiple platforms.
